profile.scope: Current L’Homme Eau de Toilette, preserving international architecture.
profile.baseline_state: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE / ZERO EMPIRICAL SIMILARITY PASS
profile.official_summary: Bergamot and white pepper lead into ginger, violet leaves and basil flower, then vetiver, tonka and cedar.
profile.target_identity: Polished citrus-white-pepper sparkle, ginger kinetics and violet-leaf/basil tension rooted in vetiver, tonka and cedar.
profile.hedonic_tension: Sharp kinetic freshness versus smooth urban woody sensuality.
profile.authority_note: International official architecture is richer than the US three-note summary; neither supplies formula amounts.

art_direction.primary_motif: White-pepper light and ginger movement flashing across metallic violet leaf.
art_direction.secondary_motif: A basil-flower kink and polished vetiver-tonka-cedar root.
art_direction.foreground: Bergamot, pepper sparkle, ginger, violet leaf and basil.
art_direction.background: Muguet/floral transmission, clean woods, tonka and musky polish.
art_direction.tension: Sharp kinetic freshness versus smooth urban sensuality.
art_direction.release: The metallic green heart is polished by floral air and descends into a clean, warm woody root.
art_direction.negative_space: Hedione and muguet materials create breathing room around ginger and violet leaf, preventing toothpaste/cucumber collision.
art_direction.recurrence: The ginger disappears after an hour, then returns as a dry warm shimmer over vetiver and cedar.
art_direction.texture_progression: pepper light → ginger snap → metallic leaf → floral polish → warm woody skin
art_direction.spatial_identity: High-definition kinetic near field with a clean polished woody aura at distance.
art_direction.late_residue: Vetiver, cedar, smooth sandalwood, tonka, incense and clean macrocyclic musk.
art_direction.controlled_imperfection: An anisic basil kink and a trace metallic leaf bitterness keep the polish from feeling corporate and generic.
art_direction.hedonic_hypothesis: Attraction comes from intelligence and motion: crisp details that resolve into effortless warmth.
layers: Bergamot, grapefruit, lemon, pepper proxy, coriander, cardamom and aldehydes create polished light.
Ginger, dihydromyrcenol, linalool, terpinyl acetate, elemi and juniper create movement.
Violet leaf, Leafovert, cis-3-hexenol, Verdox, verdyl acetate and ionones create green-metallic tension.
Verified basil plus floral/anisic context produces a tiny magnetic deviation.
Hedione, muguet, magnolia, rose/jasmine traces and jasmone smooth the recognizer without erasing it.
Vetiver, cedar, transparent woods, sandalwood, tonka and clean musks create polished persistence.
hedonic_tuning: Ginger has citrus, aromatic, resinous and floral bridges so it remains kinetic rather than sweet.
Violet leaf is distributed to avoid cucumber domination.
Basil is a tiny kink, not a pesto accord.
The base is polished and warm but deliberately lighter than La Nuit.

missing_chemical_impact.candidate: White Pepper EO/CO2 or qualified white-pepper accord
missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: Black pepper is not white pepper; it is darker, rougher and more woody-spicy.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: The bergamot opening lacks dry polished pepper light and may become ginger-only.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Toothpaste, sharp culinary pepper or trigeminal harshness.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Black-pepper control, white-pepper candidate and no-pepper control at matched perceived spice intensity over bergamot.
missing_chemical_impact.owned_functional_coverage: Black Pepper EO only; exact accord is a gap
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: Acquire or build only after a qualified white-pepper reference screen.

missing_chemical_impact.candidate: Owned Basil EO ct. Methyl Chavicol 10% bottle verification
missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: The exact stock identity, strength and solvent are not yet confirmed; basil flower is also a perceptual label, not proof of one molecule.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: The ginger-violet-leaf heart becomes smoother but less magnetic and less distinctive.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Pesto, tarragon candy or medicinal anisic green.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Verified basil stock at 0/0.5×/1×/1.5× in a fixed ginger-violet-leaf heart; blind score identity versus pesto defect.
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: Verify first; no acquisition until identity is closed.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Bergamot and white-pepper light make ginger mobile and polished.
Ginger heat moves into metallic green leaf without a hollow transition.
A tiny anisic-green kink makes the leaf signature memorable.
Muguet/floral materials soften metallic leaf without washing it out.
Green metal turns into vetiver/cedar dryness.
interaction_map.physical_test: Leaf-to-root continuity scoring at 30 min–4 h.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Tonka warms the polished root and improves skin comfort.
Clean musks give urban polish and far-field continuity.
Ginger should recur as dry warmth over tonka, not as sweetness.
High top intensity can make leaf metallic and harsh.
interaction_map.physical_test: Top block low/high at fixed total load.

test_plan.primary_comparison: Full Urban Ginger Metal versus white/black/no-pepper, basil 0/low/high, and ginger/leaf ratio controls.
test_plan.reference_gate: Current international EDT reference plus qualified white-pepper material.

temporal_test.replication: Two non-consecutive days; matched application geometry
temporal_test.core_time_question: Do ginger, violet leaf and basil remain recognizable beyond the first flash?
temporal_test.instrumental_lane: HS-SPME-GC-MS at 0/30 min/2 h/8 h on sealed vial and blotter; static and dynamic data remain separate
temporal_test.sensory_lane: Coded descriptive time-intensity plus hard-defect checklist
temporal_test.thermodynamic_inputs: Exact stock amounts, ethanol/water matrix, temperature, substrate, dose area, vapor pressure, activity-coefficient model/version
